rows.grounds: conjunction adding to the preceding list
sandhi fusion of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam; equates attainment of powers with the root Kaula teaching

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The eight accomplishments are included in the teaching.
The attainment of these accomplishments is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: Therefore, the attainment of the eight accomplishments constitutes the root Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: Whether aṣṭau refers specifically to the eight classical siddhis or to eight items implied by the preceding verses is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
